reasons.quote: Laptops and phones are supplied by IT and need a pre-approval reference at any price.
reasons.explanation: The claim is for a laptop (Notebook 14" Ryzen 7, EUR 1,450). Clause 4.1 requires a pre-approval reference for laptops at any price; the employee has provided reference PA-2026-114, satisfying this condition.

reasons.quote: Larkfield reimburses reasonable costs that an employee pays personally while doing their job.
reasons.explanation: The laptop was purchased as a replacement after a hardware failure, which is a legitimate business purpose; the cost of EUR 1,450 for a 14" Ryzen 7 / 32 GB / 1 TB SSD device is reasonable for a business-grade machine.

reasons.quote: During a business trip, Larkfield reimburses meals at their actual cost up to these limits per meal: breakfast EUR 15, lunch EUR 25, dinner EUR 45. Limits apply to the employee's own meal.
reasons.explanation: This is a solo lunch (one sandwich, one soup, one water, one coffee) claimed during a London client visit trip. At GBP 20.40, Finance's ECB conversion will produce an amount comfortably within the EUR 25 lunch limit.

reasons.quote: All amounts are in euros (EUR). Where a receipt is in another currency, Finance converts it at the European Central Bank rate on the document date; limits apply to the converted amount.
reasons.explanation: The receipt is in GBP; Finance will convert at the ECB rate on 2026-07-15. At approximately 1.18, GBP 20.40 converts to roughly EUR 24.07, which is within the EUR 25 lunch limit.

reasons.quote: Every claim states its business purpose in a sentence: what the expense was for and which project, client or trip it belongs to.
reasons.explanation: The employee has stated the purpose as a lunch during the London client visit trip for project Orion, which satisfies the business purpose requirement.
